title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend (Node.js, TypeScript, Rust)
description:
Full-time (40 hours, weekdays) backend role for a high-scale consumer platform. You'll design, build and maintain Node.js, TypeScript and Rust services, REST and GraphQL APIs, and mentor peers.
Requires 5+ years of production experience (or a related Bachelor's plus 3+ years), hands-on Node.js/TypeScript and Rust. US only.

title: Source Security Specialist
description:
Per-task contract work red-teaming frontier AI models on radiological source security. You'll write benign, dual-use and adversarial prompts, evaluate model responses against a policy standard, and write reference answers with technical rationale.
Requires experience assessing how Category 1 and 2 radioactive sources are protected or moved, plus strong technical writing. Red-teaming experience preferred.

title: Film & Video Craft Expert (Camera, VFX, Editing & Performance)
description:
Part-time (20+ hours a week, weekdays) evaluating AI-generated video for a leading AI lab. You'll compare pairs of videos on lighting, framing, camera direction, realism and performance, and write short justifications for each choice.
Requires professional experience in film, theater, editing, cinematography, VFX or animation. Paid weekly. H-1B and STEM OPT not supported.

title: Sales and Marketing Expert
description:
Hourly contract on your own schedule, building enterprise sales and marketing evaluation tasks for AI systems. Covers Fortune 500 deal scenarios, account-based marketing, demand gen and RevOps, and writing rubrics for strong GTM judgment.
Requires 5+ years in selling, marketing or RevOps at a Fortune 500 vendor or brand. Paid weekly. H-1B and STEM OPT not supported.

title: Accounting Expert
description:
Flexible contract (10–20 hours a week) comparing two AI-generated answers to accounting questions, explaining which is better on GAAP/IFRS compliance and reasoning, and writing feedback for the research team.
Requires 2+ years in accounting, audit or tax, and a CPA or accounting/finance degree. Paid weekly. H-1B and STEM OPT not supported.

title: News Analysts, Reporters, and Journalists
description:
Contract of about 4–6 weeks (20+ hours a week) evaluating AI-generated news stories and analysis for accuracy, reporting rigor, editorial soundness and clarity. Task-based pay until your first task is approved, then hourly.
Requires 4+ years as a reporter, anchor, staff writer or journalist and strong written English. US only.

title: Legal Expert
description:
Flexible contract (10–20 hours a week) comparing two AI-generated answers to legal questions and explaining which is stronger on legal accuracy, reasoning and client-readiness, with written feedback for the research team.
Requires a J.D., LL.B., LL.M. or equivalent, 2+ years practicing or researching law, and strong legal writing. Paid weekly. H-1B and STEM OPT not supported.

title: AI Assistant User – Weekly Feedback Study
description:
Ongoing weekly study where you use an AI assistant (Meta Muse or Instinct) across at least three areas of your life, log and rate the proactive messages it sends, and export your conversations with personal details removed.
Requires being an everyday user of the app for at least 2 weeks. Paid weekly. H-1B and STEM OPT not supported.

title: Generalist (Must own MacBook)
description:
Part-time remote contract (about 10–20 hours a week) on your own schedule, supporting an AI research project with a leading AI lab. You'll write high-quality research questions, answers and evaluation materials to help benchmark and improve language models.
Requires a Mac (macOS 15+), strong research and writing skills, and a master's degree (in progress or recent) or 2–3 years of relevant experience. Paid weekly. H-1B and STEM OPT not supported.

title: Senior Character Animator
description:
Part-time hourly contract reviewing AI-generated character performances shot by shot and writing actionable notes on body mechanics, facial nuance, timing and emotional intent. You'll also help define the rubric used by human reviewers.
Requires 10+ years as a senior, lead or principal character animator with feature film, VFX or AAA cinematic credits. Mostly remote, but open only to people in California or New York, with on-site sessions in Los Angeles or New York City once or twice a month. Paid weekly. H-1B and STEM OPT not supported.

title: Anonymization Writer
description:
Long-running remote contract (30+ hours a week) on a PII anonymization project. You'll confirm, reject, add and label personal information in business documents and records, group related entities, and catch what automated detection missed.
Requires prior AI data work (labeling, rating or QA), strong attention to detail and excellent written English. US-based preferred. Paid weekly. H-1B and STEM OPT not supported.

title: Project Management Specialists
description:
Contract of about 4–6 weeks (20+ hours a week) evaluating AI-generated project plans, status reports and stakeholder communications for planning rigor and feasibility. Task-based pay until your first task is approved, then hourly.
Requires 4+ years in project management or a closely related role and strong written English. US only. H-1B and STEM OPT not supported.

title: Anonymization Quality Reviewer
description:
Remote contract on a long-running PII anonymization project. You'll review completed anonymization tasks against current guidelines, approve them or request edits, and give clear, specific feedback on missed or wrongly labeled personal information.
Requires QA, editorial or compliance review experience and strong attention to detail. Paid weekly. H-1B and STEM OPT not supported.

title: AI Benchmark & Red-Teaming Specialist
description:
Contract engagement of up to 4 weeks (up to 40 hours a week, with 4 hours of overlap with Pacific time). You'll research hard-to-find facts, draft benchmark tasks that expose weaknesses in AI models, and analyze model logs to find where and why they fail.
Requires 1+ year in investigative research, fact-checking, benchmark task writing or red-teaming, and strong web search and OSINT skills. Pay is not listed.

title: Business Analyst - US Educational Raters - Gemini
description:
16-week remote project (20 hours a week, up to 40) reviewing AI responses, verifying information and writing explanations that help improve AI models. Up to $1,200 a week.
Requires an existing Gemini app account with genuine past use (at least 10 learning-related conversations), and a bachelor's degree (in progress is fine) or research, writing or analysis experience. Four hours of overlap with Pacific time.

title: Senior Software Engineer - AI Evaluation / Coding Agents
description:
Freelance contract of about 3 months (20–40 hours a week, 6+ hours of Pacific time overlap) reviewing the work of coding agents across real repositories, designing evaluation rubrics and building data pipelines.
Requires 5+ years of software engineering in Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go or similar, strong code-review skills and experience with modern LLM tools. North America only.

title: Senior Software Engineer – Go (LLM Evaluation & Repository Validation)
description:
Part-time contractor role (20, 30 or 40 hours a week, 4 hours of Pacific time overlap) triaging GitHub issues, setting up and Dockerizing repositories, and testing how well LLMs fix bugs.
Requires 3+ years of experience, strong Go, Git and Docker. Open to people in India, Pakistan, Nigeria, Kenya, Egypt, Ghana, Bangladesh, Turkey and Mexico. Pay is not listed.

title: Business Analyst - US
